branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: Twelve-pot packs of fruit-flavoured yoghurts from Piton des Neiges in Réunion, described as made with fresh milk. The Green mix has lychee, exotic fruit, strawberry and guava; the Red mix has strawberry, mango, coconut and vanilla.

sources.text: The flavours and the fresh-milk claim, from this article.
